about:
# Quick Keybind Mode

**One command, straight into keybinding.**

## Overview

World of Warcraft has a built in Quick Keybind Mode: hover any action button, press a key, and it binds instantly. No dropdowns, no scrolling through a list of every command in the game. The catch is that it sits behind the Game Menu, then Key Bindings, then a button in the corner of that panel.

QuickKeybindMode puts it one chat command away. Type `/kb` and you are binding.

## Usage

| Command | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `/kb` | Enters Quick Keybind Mode |
| `/quickkeybind` | The same thing, spelled out |
| `/qkb` | Replaces `/kb` when ElvUI is enabled, since ElvUI already uses `/kb` for its own keybind mode |

Once you are in, hover an action button and press the key you want. Press Escape or click Okay when you are finished to save your bindings.

If you type the command during combat, it tells you to wait, because the game does not allow binding changes while you are in combat.

## Supported versions

| Client | TOC | Interface |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Retail | `QuickKeybindMode.toc` | 120100 |
| World of Warcraft: Forever | `QuickKeybindMode_Camelot.toc` | 16001 |
| Classic Era, Season of Discovery, Hardcore | `QuickKeybindMode_Vanilla.toc` | 11509 |
| Anniversary (Burning Crusade) | `QuickKeybindMode_TBC.toc` | 20506 |
| Wrath Titan Reforged | `QuickKeybindMode_Wrath.toc` | 38001 |
| Classic (Mists of Pandaria) | `QuickKeybindMode_Mists.toc` | 50504 |

World of Warcraft: Forever runs the modern client, so it has the same Quick Keybind Mode as Retail and `/kb` works there unchanged.

## Installation

Install through the CurseForge app, or grab the latest release from [GitHub](https://github.com/looterz/QuickKeybindMode/releases) and drop the `QuickKeybindMode` folder into your `Interface\AddOns` directory.

## Feedback and support

Found a bug or have a suggestion? Open an issue on the [issue tracker](https://github.com/looterz/QuickKeybindMode/issues).
